limitations.note: The rewrite fixed zero detection outside reset but removed the existing one-cycle output delay and changed the reset value of `zero` from 0 to 1.

The passing test expected a set value to appear on the first rising edge after reset release and expected `zero` to be high during reset, so it validated the rewrite rather than detecting either regression.
The first simulation stopped on a testbench error: before the first set edge, this expression expected 0 even though the preceding count had left the output at 1.
